name: Bjørn Haugen
bio:
Bjørn Haugen's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not with a passion for racing, but a deep fascination with the engineering challenges. After graduating with honors in Mechanical Engineering from the Norwegian University of Science and Technology, he initially worked in the oil industry. However, the allure of pushing performance boundaries led him to motorsport. He started in rallycross, quickly adapting his skills to optimize vehicle dynamics and engine performance. 

His approach to performance engineering is holistic, focusing on the interconnectedness of various systems. He believes in data-driven decision-making, but balances it with intuitive understanding honed through years of experience. Bjørn's strength lies in his ability to translate complex technical information into actionable strategies for the drivers and mechanics. Now at Anderson Racing, he is looking to bring his decades of experience to bear on the team's performance, helping to develop a more competitive edge and refine their pit strategy.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back, thinning on top
physical.description: Bjørn is a tall, lean man with a thoughtful expression and calloused hands that betray years of hands-on work.

quirks: Always carries a small, worn notebook filled with hand-drawn schematics.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on drinking black coffee from a specific thermos he's had for over 20 years.
